rationale: Describes geocoding APIs and Hive user-defined functions for standardizing addresses, reverse geocoding coordinates, and geocoding by key. These are deterministic lookup and standardization operations; no AI, ML, or learned-model signal appears.
evidence_spans: The Global Geocoding SDK provides APIs for Spark integration as well as Hive user-defined functions for the following geocoding operations
Geocode By Key: Accepts a key (such as PreciselyID) as input and returns the standardized address and additional attribution associated with that key.
